rationale: The agent fetched user and order details but then executed a return without user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. It processed returns for four items on order #W9571698 rather than just the single more expensive tablet the user requested. It also set the refund to a gift card, despite the user’s primary request for a credit card refund and without evidence that a credit card refund was impossible. These actions are inconsistent with the user’s instructions and the policy. While the agent did attempt to identify the user, the core outcome is incorrect and unconfirmed.
